subject.title: fix(voice-call): persist assistant transcript on call.speaking events

question: Should this voice-call transcript PR carry the boot-run session and memory-ingestion changes, or should it be narrowed to the voice-call fix before further review?
rationale: The boot changes overlap current BOOT.md prompt-disclosure protections and memory transcript classification, which is a security/session-state boundary rather than routine contributor follow-up.

options.title: Narrow To Voice Fix
options.body: Resolve conflicts, keep only the voice transcript fix plus duplicate-prevention tests, and move boot-session work to a separate design review.

options.title: Review Combined Branch
options.body: Keep boot-session work in this PR, but require maintainer security review plus upgrade proof for BOOT.md and memory ingestion before merge.

options.title: Pause For Proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until the contributor adds inspectable redacted live call evidence and a rebase plan.

recommendation.title: Narrow To Voice Fix
recommendation.body: Resolve conflicts, keep only the voice transcript fix plus duplicate-prevention tests, and move boot-session work to a separate design review.
